domains.title: The record of what an agent did

questions.asks: Which actions are logged, and can I list the action names?
questions.expect: A published list of action names, filterable by prefix
questions.red_flag: Only "we log everything" — no list, no names to filter on

questions.asks: How long is the log kept, and can I export it myself?
questions.expect: A retention period you control plus an export or stream you can pull without a support ticket
questions.red_flag: An export window shorter than your review cycle, or export only on the top plan

questions.asks: Does the log cover approval decisions, credential use and admin changes — or only model calls?
questions.expect: One log covering tool calls, approvals, secret changes and admin actions
questions.red_flag: Telemetry to your SIEM offered instead of audit logging

questions.asks: Can a tool call be blocked, approved per call, or allowed to run unattended — per tool and per argument?
questions.expect: Per-tool policy with a human in the loop by default for anything that writes
questions.red_flag: A single organisation-wide toggle, or auto-approve on by default

questions.asks: Does a read-only tool need approval, and how does the platform know it is read-only?
questions.expect: The exemption applies only to tools the connector explicitly annotates as read-only
questions.red_flag: "Read-only" inferred from the request method, or every tool on a connector gated because nothing is annotated

questions.asks: What stops one agent from using another team's credentials?
questions.expect: Scopes on the agent, not on the person who created it, and credentials that never reach the sandbox
questions.red_flag: Shared service credentials, or secrets placed in the agent's working directory

questions.asks: Where do session files and conversation history live, and can an admin delete them centrally?
questions.expect: A named location, a deletion path, and a stated retention default
questions.red_flag: "On the user's computer" with no deletion endpoint and no central control

questions.asks: If I self-host, what still calls out to the vendor?
questions.expect: An explicit list of outbound calls, or none
questions.red_flag: Unclear, or licence terms that keep the control plane on the vendor's servers

questions.asks: Which model providers see my content, and can I choose them?
questions.expect: Per-project model choice with your own keys and a documented data path
questions.red_flag: One provider, no key bring-your-own, no way to know what is sent

questions.asks: If I leave, what do I take with me — agents, skills, prompts, permissions, history?
questions.expect: Configuration as files you already hold, plus an export of the run history
questions.red_flag: An export that is a JSON dump of a database you cannot read back into anything

questions.asks: Is the software I deployed still mine if the vendor changes its licence or terms?
questions.expect: A named licence for the whole tree you run, and a version you can fork
questions.red_flag: The layer you need is carved out of the open-source licence

questions.asks: What does the vendor's roadmap removal look like — has a feature you depend on ever gone away?
questions.expect: A changelog you can read, with deprecations dated
questions.red_flag: No public changelog, or features removed without a migration note
